mathematical_result: Every k >= 2 admits an a=0 polynomial counterexample b(z-z0)^k/k!. For k >= 3 there are also transcendental counterexamples (exp(lambda z)-1)^2 with lambda^(k-1)=-1/(2^(k-1)-2), b=-lambda/2. All admissible nonconstant polynomial instances are classified.
five_approach_exception: A complete rigorous counterexample was obtained in the first substantive approach.
source_formula_repair: The primary conclusion is d exp(cz)+((c-1)/c)a, not d exp(cz)+a/c. Both coincide when a=0, so the counterexamples do not depend on this repair.
limitations: The live unsolvedmath page was unavailable; catalogue wording was read from the specified fallback corpus.
